honesty: analyzer.py CANDIDATE read — counts are candidates, NOT predictions. Primary + alternative, each with its invalidation. The count is valid ONLY while its invalidation holds. Levels are the backbone; price breaking a level is the trigger, not the wave label.
subwave_note: Subwaves = ONE finer-degree ZigZag pass (lower-degree, lower-reliability — esp. sub-1h). Cap 2 degrees. A leg with no clean subdivision shows none (not invented).
